newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fedex to add Bangkok to Asian network.
newsitem.headline: Fedex to add Bangkok to Asian network.

text.p: Federal Express is to add Bangkok to its 'AsiaOne' overnight express freight network later this year, the airline's senior vice president, Asia Pacific division Michael Ducker, has told Reuters.

Fedex currently uses third party commercial carriers to connect Bangkok with its network. The Thailand link with a dedicated freighter will bring the number of Asian overnight connections to the 'AsiaOne' hub at Subic Bay in the Philippines to 14, Ducker said.
"We think Bangkok will be a great market for us and we will be starting an express service there later this year," Ducker told Reuters in an interview.

The exact start date is still unknown and it has yet not been decided how many of the six frequencies a week allowed by the bilateral rights agreement will be utilised, "probably four to six," Ducker said.

Fedex also has plans to also begin a dedicated overnight freighter service to the Indonesian capital, Jakarta, but Ducker said there is no date "pencilled in yet". -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
